visible_text: 第 1 個圖案包含 1 粒點子。對任意正整數 n，第 (n+1) 個圖案是由第 n 個圖案加上 n 粒點子所組成。求第 8 個圖案的點子數目。 (A) 22 (B) 29 (C) 36 (D) 37
reasoning: The number of dots a_n satisfies a_1=1 and a_{n+1}=a_n + n for n ≥ 1. This gives a_2 = 2, a_3 = 4, a_4 = 7, a_5 = 11, a_6 = 16, a_7 = 22, a_8 = 29. Hence the 8th figure has 29 dots, corresponding to option B.
